bio.text: Lindsay Gilchrist, a Democrat, represents District 8 (Denver) in the Colorado House of Representatives.
She has held the seat since January 2025, succeeding Leslie Herod, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was born in Denver, graduated from East High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of San Diego in 2004 and a graduate degree from UCLA in 2012.
Her career experience includes founding Gilchrist & Company and volunteering as a court appointed special advocate.
